stem.en: Why is the Sumerian script called cuneiform?

text.en: It is named after the Sumerian god of writing.

feedback.en: The name has nothing to do with a god. It comes from a Latin word, not a Sumerian one.

text.en: It comes from the Latin word for wedge, the shape of its marks.
It is named after the clay the tablets were made of.

feedback.en: Clay was the surface, but the name describes the marks on it.

text.en: It comes from the city where it was first found.

feedback.en: The name is not a place. It describes the shape of the marks.

explanation.en: Cuneus is Latin for wedge. A cut reed pressed into damp clay leaves a wedge-shaped mark, and the script is named after that shape.

hints.en: Think about what a reed leaves behind when it is pressed into clay.
